title: nepui Configuration
description: Configuration file for the nepui CLI. Defines the component installation target and the project's source directory.

$schema.description: The URL of the JSON Schema used to validate this configuration file. Enables editor autocomplete, validation, and inline documentation.

target.description: The target environment for nepui components. Use 'react' to install React components or 'html' to install plain HTML, CSS, and JavaScript components.

src.description: The root directory of your application source code, relative to the project root. The nepui CLI uses this directory as the base when resolving component installation paths.
